newsitem.title: USA: Brady debt tightens as U.S. Treasuries stumble.
newsitem.headline: Brady debt tightens as U.S. Treasuries stumble.

text.p: Brady bond spreads tightened Friday against a U.S. Treasury market devasted by two reports of strong U.S. economic growth, emerging market traders said.

Emerging debt prices sank, but not as far as U.S. government paper. JP Morgan's emerging bond index actually tightened three few basis points, with major Latin American paper leading the way, dealers said.
"We would view this as a buying opportunity and we haven't seen customers treat this any other way," one emerging market debt trader said. "We have seen moderately better buying on balance."
One large Brady bond dealer said: "The flows we had with clients were pretty large. In general they were buyers. Trading accounts turned around their positions and sold."
The benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury bond plummeted more than two full points to yield 6.45 percent on strong employment and manufacturing reports.

U.S. non-farm payrolls rose by 316,000 in July, overwhelming market expectations of a 200,000 job rise, as the unemployment rate dropped to 4.8 percent. Meanwhile, the key National Association of Purchasing Management reported its July index rose to 58.6 from 55.7 in June.

"We had a bearish day. The numbers were stronger than anybody was expecting," said one emerging market investor. "I think the markets will bounce back, but today they have have taken an unrefreshing break."
The major Latin American paper outpaced the Brady bond market, led by Argentine FRBS, which slipped 1/8 tp 95-1/8 bid and Brazil C bonds down 1-3/8 to 83-1/4 bid.
Venezuela paper lagged the market, as dealers cited a lack of demand from investors who already held long positions.
"I don't think there's anything wrong with it, but on a day like today, when the bond drops that fast, if you don't have client demand in any asset, it is going to suffer," one dealer said.
Ecuador also suffered, its PDI bonds around 15 basis points to 70-7/8.
"The extreme credits tightened more on the way up and widened more on the way down," one dealer said.
